settings.heading: Everything You Need to Know About Our Manicure and Pedicure Services

settings.text:
Our goal at Deluxe Laser and Aesthetics is simple: to make your hands and feet look and feel amazing. Whether you want a quick refresh or a full pamper session, our range of manicure and pedicure options can be tailored to your needs. We pay close attention to nail health, ensuring cuticles are gently treated and nails are shaped to your liking. Enjoy a revitalising scrub, a hydrating treatment, and a calming massage, followed by a professional polishing or gel application for a flawless finish.

  • Customised Treatments: We adapt each session to your specific preferences, from classic manicures to gel or acrylic options.
  • Hygiene & Safety: Our tools and equipment are sterilised according to strict protocols, so you can relax knowing you’re in safe hands.
  • Expert Technicians: Our staff is trained to deliver the highest level of care, guaranteeing consistent results.
  • Online Booking & Loyalty Points: Schedule your manicure or pedicure online and collect points for future services.

rich_text_yVp3jc.name: Everything You Need to Know About Our Manicure and Pedicure Services

settings.text:
• Classic Manicure: Nail shaping, cuticle care, massage, and polish.
  • Gel/Biosculpture Manicure: a long-lasting, chip-resistant colour with a mirror finish.
  • Deluxe Manicure: Includes scrub, mask, massage, and extended nail care for ultimate pampering.
  • Classic Pedicure: Foot soak, exfoliation, nail shaping, cuticle care, massage, and polish.
  • Gel/Shellac Pedicure: A durable, high-gloss colour that withstands daily wear.
  • Deluxe Pedicure: Adds a deeply hydrating treatment and extended foot massage to the classic service.

You can book single treatments or combine a manicure and pedicure for a full-service experience. We also offer add-ons like nail art, French tips, and paraffin wax treatments for extra hydration.

settings.heading: What You Need to Know Before Your Manicure or Pedicure

settings.text:
To ensure you get the most from your visit, here are a few simple steps to follow and what you can expect:

  • Pre-Treatment: Arrive with clean nails (if possible). If you’re wearing gel polish, please let us know in advance so we can schedule extra time for removal.
  • During Treatment: Relax! Our technicians will gently tend to your nails and skin, using products suited to your individual needs.
  • Post-Treatment: Your nails will be ready to show off immediately if you choose a classic polish; just allow a bit of drying time. If you opt for gel, your nails will cure instantly under a safe LED lamp.
  • Long-Term Benefits: Regular manicures and pedicures help prevent ingrown nails, promote healthy nail growth, and keep your hands and feet feeling smooth and hydrated.

settings.heading: How long does a manicure or pedicure take?
settings.content: Treatments typically last between 30 and 30–60 minutes, depending on whether you choose a classic or deluxe service.

settings.heading: How often should I get a manicure or pedicure?
settings.content: For best results, we recommend every 2–4 weeks, depending on your lifestyle and nail growth.

settings.heading: Is gel or classic polish better?
settings.content: Gel polish offers a longer-lasting finish, ideal for busy schedules or special events. Classic polish is perfect if you enjoy changing colours frequently or prefer traditional formulas.

settings.heading: Can I upgrade to a more luxurious treatment?
settings.content: Absolutely! You can add scrubs, masks, or even an extended massage to elevate your experience.
